type.description: The job type, normalized to the caption of the type_id value. In the case of 'Other', it is defined by the event source.
type.caption: Type

file.description: The file that pertains to the job.
file.caption: File

user.description: The user that created the job.
user.caption: User

3.description: The job is executed by systemd on Linux.
3.caption: Systemd

0.description: The job orchestration mechanism is unknown.
0.caption: Unknown

1.description: The job is executed by the Task Scheduler on Windows.
1.caption: Task Scheduler

2.description: The job is executed by cron on Linux, macOS, or another a Unix-like OS.
2.caption: Cron

99.description: The job orchestration mechanism is not mapped. See the type attribute, which contains a data source specific value.
99.caption: Other

4.description: The job is executed by launchd on macOS.
4.caption: Launchd

type_id.description: The job type, i.e. the mechanism that executes the job.
type_id.caption: Type ID

created_time.description: The time when the job was created.
created_time.caption: Created Time

job_actions.description: An array of actions that will be performed by the job when certain conditions are met.
job_actions.caption: Job Actions

job_triggers.description: An array of conditions or events that, when met, will initiate the job to perform specified actions.
job_triggers.caption: Job Triggers

last_run_time.description: The time when the job was last run.
last_run_time.caption: Last Run

next_run_time.description: The time when the job will next be run.
next_run_time.caption: Next Run

run_state.description: The run state of the job.
run_state.caption: Run State

99.description: The run state is not mapped. See the run_state attribute, which contains a data source specific value.
99.caption: Other

run_state_id.description: The run state ID of the job.
run_state_id.caption: Run State ID

created_time_dt.description: The time when the job was created.
created_time_dt.caption: Created Time

last_run_time_dt.description: The time when the job was last run.
last_run_time_dt.caption: Last Run

next_run_time_dt.description: The time when the job will next be run.
next_run_time_dt.caption: Next Run

name: job
description: The Job object provides information about a scheduled job or task, including its name, command line, and state. It encompasses attributes that describe the properties and status of the scheduled job.
caption: Job
